description: This file provides documentation and usage examples for the Core::File API in a C++ codebase. It covers various file operations such as checking existence, creating, deleting, moving, reading, writing, appending, and reading line-by-line, as well as directory handling and path normalization.

classes.name: Core::File
classes.description: Represents a file and provides methods for common filesystem operations such as checking existence, creating, deleting, moving, reading contents, and writing data.

classes.name: Core::Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory and allows directory operations like creation, deletion, and iteration over contents.

classes.name: Core::TextReader
classes.description: Reads lines or text from file-like objects, used for line-by-line processing.

classes.name: Core::TextFragment
classes.description: Encapsulates a line of text read from a file, providing methods to check if the line is empty and to access its textual content.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if the specified file exists.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new file or overwrites an existing file.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Deletes the specified file or directory.

methods.name: Move
methods.description: Moves or renames the file to a new location.

methods.name: Extension
methods.description: Returns the extension of a file without the leading dot.

methods.name: Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a path to prevent traversal vulnerabilities, returning a safe path and indicating validity.
